bayts.text: The winds aided him just as the spears aided him, and he had no need of weapons, through his Lord who honours.
O Lord, bless forever the Prophet Aḥmad (Muḥammad), his Family, people of right guidance, and his Companions, and grant peace.
O Lord, bless forever the Prophet who worshipped You, his Family, people of munificence, and his Companions, and grant peace.
O Lord, bless at every moment Your trustworthy Messenger, his Family, people of certainty, and his Companions, and grant peace.
O Lord, bless through the ages him who erased perdition, his Family, people of delight, and his Companions, and grant peace.
O Lord, bless every year the Prophet, the best of mankind, and his Family, perpetually, and his Companions, and grant peace.
O Lord, bless at all times the Eloquent one of recollected silence, his Family, people of devotion, and his Companions, and grant peace.
O Lord, bless by day the Prophet, pride (of the line) of Nizār, his Family, people of glory, and his Companions, and grant peace.
O Lord, bless in the morning the Prophet, rich in righteousness, his Family, people of success, and his Companions, and grant peace.
Pour forth blessing and peace, in the evening and the night, O You who are the Holy (Al-Quddūs), upon the chief of chiefs, the best of creatures, my ladder (to You).
O Lord, bless with peace the Prophet, perpetually, and the Family and the noble Companions, and through him accept my composition.
Bless the lion (Muḥammad) who healed (hearts) on the day of Badr, when he kept faith, with the Companions of pure faith (al-ḥunafāʾ), with his magnified covenant.
Grant peace to the Full Moon (Muḥammad) who dispelled the darkness of hearts and rose high, to those of the sublime stations and his company, and magnify them.
The best of mankind arose amid the choicest of companies, against the arrogant, like the full moon amid the stars.
A day on which the struggle grew fierce, a day on which the battle grew fierce, the day men knew one another, the day of good pleasure and of dismay.
That day was success for the rightly guided, and gain; for the one who ascends, and righteousness, for every Muslim.
A day on which the Lord of creation forgave the sins of those who took part in his battle, the grave as well as the slight.
The Companions, people of good, met there the companions (of Quraysh), people of harm; and both alike were furious lions, of lofty resolve.
They vied with one another for death, and each of them was valiant, longing for the meeting (with God) or to be struck down, for love of the Effacer of sorrows (Muḥammad).
And they fought those whose deaths the Intercessor of intercessors (Muḥammad) had foretold, until the dust rose between the coward and the champion.
Then there came down from heaven cavalry and a mighty army to the chief of the noble (Muḥammad), bringing joy without distress.
The Lord of mankind reinforced him with an army of mighty angels, for (increasing) the number, not for close combat: they struck down the arrogant.
And among them, when they arrived, was his glorified intimate friend, Gabriel — how excellent a support! — upon a mighty steed.
And they rushed to the fray with swords and spears, for love of righteousness and success, behind the supreme Imām (Muḥammad).
And among them was the one who realised (faith), our master, the divinely favoured, the most sincere of those who believed in the illustrious Hāshimite (Muḥammad):
his Truthful one (Aṣ-Ṣiddīq, Abū Bakr), the magnified, possessor of majesty, the revered, his patient companion in the cave, second only to the Most Knowing (the Prophet).
And among them was the one to whom every good was foretold, ʿUmar, our master, the man of counsel, the glory of every Muslim.
And among them was he who married the two daughters of the chief of the righteous (Muḥammad), the Two Lights, when they prospered through the remission of every sin:
our master, the adorned one, ʿUthmān, whom they slew while he was reciting the Book of Him (Allah) who gives abundantly.
And among them was he who dispelled idolatry, father of Al-Ḥusayn and Al-Ḥasan, gate of the sciences, the son-in-law (of the Prophet), father of the noble stars:
our master, the honoured, his magnified ʿAlī, who fells the enemies, the fearless lion, effacer of harm and of sorrow.
Through that day we have gained security from fear, from toil and shame, from anguish and remorse.
Through it (the day of Badr) we have been spared, with a view to the Gardens, expedition and humiliation; through it time has become propitious for us, with the acceptance of (our) services.
So let us praise God for our deliverance from whoever hated us and from every decreed evil, through the Chosen One (Muḥammad), placed before all.
Truly I address the Beautiful (Allah) for him (Muḥammad), for the upright Family and for his Companions, without their falling into obscurity, with "bless" and "grant peace".
O our Lord, O our Lord, O our Intimate Friend, O our Beloved, bless our master Muḥammad and grant peace,
and his Family, his Companions and whoever is attached to him among the Saints of his company; and accept my pen.
Be well pleased with the noble Companions, with a good pleasure that leads to me what I long for; and be with me, O Lord of mankind, without enemies or pain.
Accept my blessing upon our master, Gate of the heights, and accept this ode for Your noble Face.
O our Lord, bless the best of the Prophets ever sent, Muḥammad, increase the exaltation of his community, and grant peace.
O our Lord, bless the best of Messengers, the favoured one, Muḥammad; make my writing sweet as honey, and grant peace.
O our Lord, bless the best of Prophets, the exalted one, Muḥammad; through him accept my script, and grant peace.
O our Lord, bless the best of Messengers, the venerated one, Muḥammad; through him adorn my state with beauty, and grant peace.
O our Lord, bless the best of intercessors, whose intercession is accepted, Muḥammad; through him bring my aim to completion, and grant peace.
